clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the apple orchard, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter spending long hours away in the trees and June hardly seeing him, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir by September with her letters thinning out. The shifts pile up from May 1952 through September 1953 around this change in the family's home and work.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily by June, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank by November, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found that May, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning by October 1969. The shifts pile up from June 1968 through October 1969 around this loss of the orchard and the family's move to Ridgeport.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's loss of his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and saying little to her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it by December, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976. The shifts pile up from May 1975 through June 1976 around this change in Glen's work and the family's financial trouble.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990 when she sold her farm: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals by April, Hollis working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool and being sent home twice, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights by November, Wilma taking a flat in town by June 1991, and Nora's eczema clearing over the summer. The shifts pile up from April 1990 through August 1991 around Wilma joining the household.
